title_lines: Crusoe CEO回应新云板块波动
算力需求强劲支撑市场信心
债务成本上升但订单依然稳固

subtitles.en: So, over the last 10 days there's been a lot of angst, agita, whatever word you want to choose in the NeoCloud and AI infrastructure space about the amount of debt and risk and whether there's a bubble.
subtitles.zh: 过去10天，新云和AI基础设施领域有很多焦虑和不安，关于债务和风险规模，以及是否存在泡沫。
你怎么看？我听说过一些。

subtitles.en: Look, I mean, I think people are very focused on the public companies, the public NeoClouds like CoreWeaven, Nibius.
subtitles.zh: 我认为人们非常关注上市公司，比如CoreWeave、Nebius这些公开的新云公司。

subtitles.en: And, you know, I'm not, you know, I don't have the exact intimate details of all the different contracts that they've signed.
subtitles.zh: 我没有他们所有合同的具体细节。

subtitles.en: But, you know, generally speaking, I think we are very focused on the demand side of this equation.
subtitles.zh: 但总的来说，我们非常关注这个等式的需求侧。

subtitles.en: And, you know, we do have a lot of insight in terms of what we're seeing from a demand perspective, both with, you know, the very big buyers of compute,
subtitles.zh: 我们从需求角度有很多洞察，无论是大型算力买家，

subtitles.en: as well as sort of the long tail of demand.
And, you know, what we are seeing today is an overwhelming tidal wave of demand and it is deep and it is broad.
subtitles.zh: 我们今天看到的是压倒性的需求浪潮，既深又广。

subtitles.en: And so, you know, from our perspective, you know, not having all of the exact details of all the different contracts and all the different loan agreements, etc.
subtitles.zh: 所以，虽然我们没有所有合同和贷款协议的具体细节，

subtitles.en: You know, I do pretty firmly believe that a lot of this, you know, angst is overblown and is a bit of an overreaction.
subtitles.zh: 但我坚信，很多焦虑被夸大了，有点反应过度。

subtitles.en: You know, I know CoreWeaven has made some very good deals.
subtitles.zh: 你知道，我知道CoreWeave已经达成了一些非常好的交易。
en_highlights: CoreWeaven has made some very good deals

subtitles.en: The deals they have in place, they are very good deals.
subtitles.zh: 他们现有的交易，都是非常好的交易。

terms.context: AI infrastructure companies renting GPU compute, distinct from hyperscalers
CEO's view that market fears are exaggerated

clip_research.source_claim: Crusoe CEO says the recent neocloud selloff and debt/bubble fears are overblown and an overreaction, citing an overwhelming tidal wave of demand.
clip_research.public_baseline: Public reporting shows a sharp October neocloud selloff driven by CoreWeave debt fears, with CoreWeave market value falling from a near-$90B peak to about $31B and Nebius/IREN also dropping sharply; Gartner warned most neoclouds may not survive to 2030.
clip_research.surprise_gap: The CEO of a private neocloud dismisses the debt-driven selloff as overblown while public markets and credit markets are pricing distress, creating a clear insider-vs-consensus tension.

evidence.fact: CEO says 'a lot of this angst is overblown and is a bit of an overreaction' and cites 'an overwhelming tidal wave of demand'.
